summary: Iteration 2 testing of the 4 new features plus the CORS/login fix. Backend: 30/30 pytest pass. That covers CORS preflight (Emergent origin echoed with credentials; evil.com and the emergentagent.com.evil.com suffix attack rejected with 400), manual and AI quest save/validate/delete, step XP, shares add/re-share/remove/422/400 (self), and the observation author. Multi-user sharing was tested with AUTH_ENABLED=true and 3 Bearer sessions: the guest sees the child with owner_name, can read and write observations (author=Guest User), gets 403 on DELETE child and on share management, and loses access after unshare; an unrelated user gets 404. AUTH_ENABLED was reverted to false and the temporary users were deleted. Frontend: /interventions AI quest generation works (~10s), IA pill shows, steps cycle and give +50 XP, the done count updates. Detail panel Actions tab compact generate-quest-open works (no domain select). Notifications and timeline include custom quests. /carte shows name, stars, badges and wins, and print works. The overview-progress-card and doc-progress-card-link links work. Documents generate without polluting history (ai_messages count unchanged). AI settings local/cloud switch persists in localStorage. The test shows 'Injoignable', and the assistant header shows 'IA locale · mistral'. Sending a local message shows assistant-error without a crash. Switching back to Cloud streams again. The drawer race from iteration 1 is fixed (explore-scenario gives a separate user bubble and a separate answer). The dead-center medallion click now works. Observation author 'Mode démo' shows next to the date.

minor.issue: Deleting a custom quest keeps the XP from its 'fait' steps and leaves orphan quest_steps['cq_x:i'] entries (confirmed: 230 XP stayed 230 after deleting a quest with 1 done step; orphan key cq_32cd67d298:0 left in DB). This allows XP farming: generate, mark done, delete, repeat. Fix: subtract XP_STEP for each done step and $unset the quest_steps keys.
chat.send_message() is outside the try block, so an LLM/network error gives an unhandled 500 instead of the 502 French message.

The user message is saved before streaming. Interrupted or failed streams leave orphan user messages (found 2 consecutive orphan user messages in Léo's history), and these are then re-sent in the transcript.
Debug 'PREFLIGHT ORIGIN' print middleware is still active. Remove it before release.

Shared users can DELETE /assistant (clear the owner's chat history), DELETE custom quests and PUT the child profile (name/notes). Confirm this is intended; consider owner-only for destructive actions.

ui_bugs.issue: A 422 validation error shows '[object Object]' (e.g. email 'a@b' passes the HTML5 email check but the backend rejects it). api.ts does `throw new Error(body.detail)` where detail is a Pydantic array. Fix: if Array.isArray(detail), map to msg, or show a French message like 'Adresse e-mail invalide'.

When Ollama is unreachable the error is the raw browser text 'Failed to fetch' (English, not explained), and the user's typed message disappears (msgs reset to history, input cleared). Show a French hint (e.g. 'IA locale injoignable : lancez Ollama avec OLLAMA_ORIGINS=*') and restore the input text.
Uses <li key={s.title}>. AI-generated steps with duplicate titles would collide. Use the index as key.

issues: The header row does not stack: the avatar and level ring squeeze the title column to about 90px, so 'ENFANCE+ · CARTE DE PROGRÈS' and the tagline wrap word-by-word. Stack vertically below sm.
Long AI quest titles wrap next to the IA/progress/delete pills; acceptable but tight

action_items: On custom quest delete: subtract XP for done steps and unset quest_steps keys
Format Pydantic 422 detail arrays in lib/api.ts (SharePanel shows [object Object])
Wrap LlmChat.send_message in try/except in generate_quest (return 502)
Friendlier French error for local AI fetch failure; keep the user's typed input
Remove the debug PREFLIGHT ORIGIN middleware
Make the /carte header responsive on mobile
Decide whether shared users may clear assistant history, delete quests or edit the profile
critical_code_review_comments: AssistantDrawer: the history load effect depends on `local` and re-runs with assistant.prompt when the provider changes while the drawer is open, which could re-send the last prompt. Clear the prompt after use.
QuestCard delete uses window.confirm (native dialog) and has no error handling (unhandled rejection on failure); the same applies to the share remove button
localAi streamLocal: JSON.parse on each NDJSON line has no try/catch, and the leftover buffer after the loop is never parsed (the last line is lost if it has no trailing newline)
list_children does one users.find_one per shared child (N+1). Fine at this scale.
